# Planning Framework v1.0 — Reference

**Framework Version:** 1.0

Installed by the v1 `setup-planning-framework.sh`.

v1 has no issue folders at all: everything lives in the three global documents
(`implementation-plan.md`, `session-log.md`, `decisions.md`) plus `docs/prd.md`.

NOTE for converge: this file sits under `docs/planning/`, NOT under `planning/`,
so it is not on the deletion whitelist and SURVIVES converge (see TC-003 / TC-019
— `docs/planning/FRAMEWORK.md` may exist on the v1 path, and must never be
*created* on the v2 path).
